ideas.name: C1: Depth sweep ensemble
ideas.description: Fit XGBTreeHFD at several depth_variable values (e.g. 2, 3, 4). For each interaction column, keep the candidate fit with lowest residual MSE on a validation split, reassembling components so each remains a function of only its own variables. Average predictions over seeds to reduce variance.

ideas.name: C2: Prune weak interactions
ideas.description: Fit TreeHFD with interaction_order=2 and full interaction_list, then compute each interaction's marginal contribution (variance of its component minus residual MSE change when dropped) on validation data. Refit keeping only interactions above a threshold, so the decomposition drops noisy high-order terms that inflate residual MSE.

ideas.name: C3: Least-squares recalibration
ideas.description: After TreeHFD fit, take component matrices M (intercept, main effects, interactions) and solve a constrained least-squares refit of coefficients against model predictions on training data (scipy.optimize.lsq_linear, nonnegative or free). Coefficients multiply each existing component, preserving each component's dependence on only its own variables.
